svg.text: A drowned lake of glass, in the luminous style (art-style-guide.md, section 7, Question SC). Placeholder figures from the kits; what's on test is the color.
The gold is low and thin: a dawn haze on the
Wet sage ground, so the warm heroes still pop and
the drowned teal enemies sit back.
Water is glassy shallows with pale glints, never
Mist bands and sunken bell towers say drowned;
Most motes are aquamarine now: the rift is nearer.
